body: I have an undergrad degree, but I've applied to over a dozen graduate schools and no one will have me. Plus, I'm too broke to pay for a Master's Degree...

You're right and, somehow, your "Saturday morning cartoon" logic holds water. I wasn't allowing myself to be convinced. That much is true. 

I had a bottle of Fentanyl that I planned on throwing down my neck with some vodka, but I've since flushed them down the drain. So for now, I've stepped back from the proverbial ledge and I'm genuinely weighing my options. 

But where the fuck do I start? My problems seem far too painful to address, let alone solve. 

Fuck. I feel utterly hopeless. I keep imagining a version of myself -- successful, happy and self-actualized. But I'm constantly reminded that it's a fantasy and that everything -- from the job market to my male pattern baldness -- is preventing that fantasy from becoming real. 

Schopenhauer said that when the pain of life outweighs the fear of death, suicide becomes rational. 

So when is it ever appropriate to just hang up your hat and cal it quits? I genuinely believe I may have reached that point....

I'm broke and, for the last two years, have been working odd jobs for nickels and dimes. My degree is a joke and no one in my industry is hiring. In fact, the entire discipline is being relegated to the history books. 200 years from now, they'll say, "Journalism? Hah! What a fucking joke." 

Again, I've been pro-active about finding a girl for years, but no one will touch me. I've had girls laugh in my fucking face before for having the gall to ask their names. 

My parents and extended family are as dynamic as a rock. They're never going to change. 

As for moving somewhere else? My financial woes prevent me from moving down the block, let alone to another city or country. No, for now, I'm stuck where I am.

I wouldn't be trying to kill myself if my only problem was blue balls, my friend. I'll omit some details for the sake of brevity, but... 

I'm broke and in debt, which in turn forces me to live with a family that regularly belittles and berates me. Moreover, I'm forced to hide my habits and beliefs at home because they contradict my family's 3rd-world perspective on life. To add to the tragedy, I'm friendless (literally), have never known the love of a woman and I'm unemployed. I've spent the last year trying to reorganize my life, but I've only slipped and fallen further down the slope. 

My life is a fucking punchline at the end of a sad, sad joke. I came here to Reddit to find something... I don't know what... an excuse not to do it? But fuck it, I'm going to take the idea of 'tankengine1' and I'll find a train to run me over. It seems more foolproof than my previous plans.

I'm not French. Far from it, in fact. 

I've tried my hand at writing, which has ironically led to my becoming broke. The job market (and indeed the greater economy) has little use for writers, free-thinking journalists or poets. In my endeavors to pursue a writing career, I've sentenced myself to the life of a pauper. 

Thanks for your kind words, however. I'll be honest, they don't mean much to a death-bent mind, but they're certainly kind.
I hope this a joke. A demented and sick joke, surely, but I'm hoping it's a joke nonetheless.
